_meta.source_document: UAE Fire and Life Safety Code of Practice (CDGH-OP-25), September 2018 edition (1348 pages)
_meta.extraction_scope: Full Bucket 1 Plan-Verifiable dataset covering Chapters 1 through 20 and Annexures 1 and 2
_meta.legal_notice: This structured dataset was extracted by automated document analysis and cross-referenced against the official UAE FLS Code of Practice (CDGH-OP-25). It serves as an automated pre-check engineering reference and does not constitute a final legal or authority approval.

clauses.note: Lowrise buildings: Height up to 15m (up to G+3/4 floors). Baseline fire safety provisions apply.
Midrise buildings: Height from >15m up to 23m. Sprinkler protection and enclosed stairs required.
Highrise buildings: Height from >23m up to 90m. Fire lifts, pressurization, and voice alarm required.
Super Highrise buildings: Height >90m. Refuge floors, redundant fire pumps, and secondary water required.
Fire pump room must be enclosed in 2-hour fire-rated construction with direct exterior access door.
Fire Command Center must have 2-hour fire rating, direct exterior access or dedicated protected corridor.
Oil-filled transformer rooms must be enclosed in 3-hour fire-rated construction with blast relief and bund.
Emergency generator room must have 2-hour fire-rated enclosure and acoustic fire dampers.
Commercial kitchens must be separated by 2-hour fire rated walls and equipped with UL300 hood suppression.
Cold storage rooms >20 m2 must be enclosed in 2-hour fire-rated partitions with approved sandwich panels.
No openings are allowed in exterior walls situated less than 1.0m from property boundaries.
0% unprotected openings permitted if non-sprinklered (15% permitted if fully sprinklered).
Maximum 10% unprotected opening area in exterior wall per storey (25% if sprinklered).
Maximum 15% unprotected opening area per storey (unlimited if fully sprinklered).
Maximum 25% unprotected opening area per storey (unlimited if fully sprinklered).
Maximum 45% unprotected opening area per storey (unlimited if fully sprinklered).
Maximum 70% unprotected opening area per storey (unlimited if fully sprinklered).
Unlimited unprotected openings permitted for setbacks 9.0m or greater.
Vertical spandrel separation between openings in adjacent storeys must be at least 915mm (1-hr fire rated).
Fire apparatus access roadways must have minimum unobstructed width of 6.0m.
Minimum vertical overhead clearance of 4.5m along all fire access routes.
Minimum inside turning radius for fire department heavy apparatus is 12.0m.
Maximum slope/gradient of fire access roads and hardstandings is 10% (1 in 10).
Highrise buildings must provide fire vehicle access to at least 50% of the total building perimeter.
Super highrise buildings and malls require 100% perimeter access (minimum 75% subject to Civil Defence approval).
Fire apparatus hardstanding must be located at least 3.0m from the building facade.
Fire apparatus hardstanding must be located within 10.0m of the building facade for aerial reach.
A fire hydrant must be located within 18m of the building Fire Department Connection (Siamese / FDC).
Maximum spacing between external fire hydrants along public roads in urban/commercial zones is 100m.
Used to calculate occupant load: floor area (m2) divided by 9.3 = occupant load
Applies where a floor is open-plan/high desk-density rather than regular cellular offices

clauses.occupancy: Assembly - Concentrated (Chairs only, Auditoriums, Places of Worship)
clauses.note: Concentrated assembly without fixed seats (0.65 m2 net per person).

clauses.occupancy: Assembly - Less Concentrated (Dining, Banquet, Conference, Exhibit)
clauses.note: Tables and chairs dining/conference arrangement (1.4 m2 net per person).

clauses.occupancy: Assembly - Standing Space (Waiting areas, Concert standing)
clauses.note: Dense standing room / queue area (0.28 m2 net per person).
Mall food court dining seating areas (1.4 m2 per person).
Fitness club / gym workout room with equipment (4.6 m2 per person).
Gaming floor / entertainment arcade (1.0 m2 per person).
Standard school / university classroom space (1.9 m2 net per person).
Science labs, vocational workshops, computer labs (4.6 m2 net per person).
Preschool, kindergarten, nursery rooms (3.3 m2 net per person).
Hospital inpatient surgical, ICU, and treatment units (22.3 m2 gross per person).
Hospital patient bedroom wards (11.1 m2 gross per person).
Outpatient surgical and ambulatory health center (13.0 m2 gross per person).
Multi-family residential apartments (18.6 m2 gross per person).

clauses.occupancy: Residential - Hotel Guest Rooms and Hotel Apartments
clauses.note: Hotels, motels, serviced hotel apartments (18.6 m2 gross per person).
Staff accommodation, student hostels, and labor housing (18.6 m2 gross per person).

clauses.occupancy: Mercantile - Sales area on street floor or below
clauses.note: Retail sales floor at ground/street level or basement (2.8 m2 per person).

clauses.occupancy: Mercantile - Sales area on floors above street floor
clauses.note: Retail sales on upper shopping levels (5.6 m2 per person).
Shopping mall concourse / retail area under 14,000 m2 GLA (2.8 m2 per person).
Regional shopping mall concourse area (3.3 m2 per person).

clauses.occupancy: Storage - Low and Ordinary Hazard Storage / Warehouse
clauses.note: General warehouse storage and stockrooms (27.9 m2 per person).
General manufacturing / industrial workshop area (9.3 m2 per person).
Multi-storey covered or basement car parking garage (27.9 m2 per person).
Baseline minimum number of exits regardless of occupant load
Floor occupant load up to 500 requires minimum 2 remote exits.
Floor occupant load between 500 and 1000 requires minimum 3 remote exits.
Floor occupant load exceeding 1000 requires minimum 4 remote exits.
Separation between the two remote exits must be at least 1/3 of the floor diagonal.
Separation between the two remote exits must be at least 1/2 of the floor diagonal.
Exits measured in straight line between center of doors must be at least 1/3 of floor diagonal.
Common path in assembly spaces (max 23m in sprinklered spaces).
Dead ends in assembly spaces must not exceed 6.1m (20 ft).
Maximum travel distance to exit in sprinklered assembly spaces.
Dead ends in hospital corridors must not exceed 9.1m (30 ft).
Maximum travel distance from tenant entry along smoke-protected concourse to exterior exit.
Maximum travel distance within tenant retail space to the mall concourse entrance.
Minimum clear opening width for any egress door leaf is 900mm (35.4 in).
Maximum width of a single egress door leaf is 1200mm (48 in).
Doors serving an occupant load >=50 persons or high hazard rooms must swing in direction of egress.
Minimum clear width of exit stair serving cumulative occupant load up to 2000 persons.
Minimum clear width of exit stair serving cumulative occupant load exceeding 2000 persons.
Maximum riser height for new exit stairs is 180mm (7 in).
Minimum tread depth for new exit stairs is 280mm (11 in).
Absolute minimum corridor width unless larger width is required by occupant load capacity.
Minimum corridor width in schools with classrooms on one side is 1830mm (6 ft).
Minimum corridor width in schools with classrooms on both sides is 3000mm (10 ft).
Minimum clear corridor width for patient bed movement in hospital inpatient units is 2440mm (8 ft).
A single exit door is allowed only if occupant load <100 AND exit discharges directly outside with travel to outside <=30m.
Any office room exceeding 280 m2 requires 2 exit doors remotely located regardless of occupant load.
Any classroom or student space exceeding 93 m2 (1000 sq ft) requires 2 separate remote exit doors.
Any hospital sleeping room or patient suite exceeding 93 m2 requires 2 separate remote exit doors.
If more than one exit exists, losing any single exit must leave >=50% of total required capacity.

clauses.occupancy: Any - Class A Fire Hazard (Ordinary combustibles)
clauses.note: Maximum walking travel distance to a Class A portable fire extinguisher is 23.0m (75 ft).

clauses.occupancy: Any - Class B Fire Hazard (Flammable liquids)
clauses.note: Maximum walking travel distance to a Class B portable fire extinguisher is 15.2m (50 ft).
Maximum travel distance to a wet chemical Class K extinguisher in commercial kitchen is 9.0m (30 ft).
Minimum 1 portable fire extinguisher provided for every 200 m2 of floor area or fraction thereof.
Top of extinguisher <=18kg must be mounted not more than 1.5m (5 ft) above the finished floor.
Top of extinguisher >18kg must be mounted not more than 1.0m (3.5 ft) above the finished floor.
Maximum viewing distance / spacing between directional illuminated exit signs along corridors is 30m.
Bottom of overhead illuminated exit sign must be at least 2.0m above the finished floor level.
Emergency lighting along exit access paths, corridors, and stairs must provide minimum average 1.1 lux.
Emergency lighting across open office floors and public halls must provide minimum average 0.5 lux.

clauses.occupancy: Fire Pump, Generator, and Electrical Rooms
clauses.note: Dedicated emergency illumination inside fire pump rooms, FCC, and switchgear rooms must be at least 10.8 lux.

clauses.occupancy: Exit Doors, First Aid, and Call Points
clauses.note: An emergency luminaire must be installed within 2.0m horizontally of every exit door, MCP, and first aid point.
Emergency lighting central battery or self-contained luminaire must provide at least 3.0 hours duration.
Two-way firefighter telephone station/jack must be provided on every floor landing inside each fire stair.
Two-way firefighter warden communication station mandatory in designated fire service lift lobby at every floor.
Wall-mounted telephone appliance or jack must be mounted between 910mm and 1680mm above floor level.
Point smoke detector coverage radius is 7.5m (maximum 100 m2 coverage area per detector on flat ceiling).
Point heat detector coverage radius is 5.3m (maximum 50 m2 coverage area per detector on flat ceiling).
Maximum walking travel distance from any point on a floor to the nearest manual call point (MCP) is 30m.
A manual call point must be located within 2.0m of every exit stair entrance door and exterior exit door.
Automatic sprinkler system is mandatory for any commercial or residential building exceeding 15m height.
Maximum allowable distance between standard spray sprinkler heads in light hazard spaces is 4.6m (15 ft).
Maximum protection floor area per sprinkler head for standard light hazard rooms is 21.0 m2.
Maximum allowable distance between sprinkler heads in ordinary hazard spaces is 4.0m.
Maximum protection floor area per sprinkler head in ordinary hazard rooms is 12.0 m2.
Sprinkler head deflector must be located at least 100mm (4 in) away from adjacent wall surfaces.
Maximum distance from any sprinkler head to adjacent wall must not exceed 2.3m (half the allowable head spacing).
Standard Fire Hose Reel (FHR) tubing length is 30.0m (19mm or 25mm diameter).
Effective water jet stream throw allowance for FHR coverage is 6.0m.
Total coverage reach (30m hose + 6m throw = 36m) must reach every point of the floor from an FHR cabinet.
A 65mm (2.5 in) landing valve must be provided on intermediate landing of every exit stair at every floor.
4-way or 2-way Siamese Fire Department Connection (FDC) required on external street-facing facade.
Maximum length of exit access corridor without a smoke barrier partition and door is 60.0m.
Maximum floor area of any single smoke compartment zone is 2000 m2.
Staircase mechanical pressurization system must maintain minimum 50 Pa positive differential across closed doors.
Minimum air velocity through open exit doors to prevent smoke ingress into stair enclosure is 1.0 m/s.
Mechanical ventilation for enclosed car parks must supply/exhaust at least 6 air changes per hour for CO control.
Car park emergency smoke clearance extract rate must be at least 10 air changes per hour (or reversible jet fans).

clauses.occupancy: LPG Bulk Tank (<=2000 L water capacity)
clauses.note: LPG tank <=2000L must be located at least 3.0m from buildings, property boundaries, and ignition sources.

clauses.occupancy: LPG Bulk Tank (2001 L - 7500 L capacity)
clauses.note: LPG tank 2001L to 7500L must be located at least 7.5m from buildings and property lines.
LPG and flammable gas piping is strictly prohibited from passing through exit stairs, lift shafts, or ducts.

clauses.occupancy: Diesel Fuel Generator Day Tank / Storage
clauses.note: Secondary containment bund wall must hold at least 110% of the total storage capacity of the fuel tank.
Maximum volume of diesel fuel day tank permitted inside a building in a 2-hour dedicated room is 2500L (660 gal).
Emergency manual fuel shutoff button required outside the entrance door of every fuel/generator room.
Substation rooms housing primary switchgear and transformers must be enclosed in 3-hour fire rated construction.
Electrical transformer room must have access door opening directly to the building exterior for fire access.
Rooftop GSM equipment cabins and tower bases must maintain at least 3.0m clear setback from roof parapet edge.

clauses.occupancy: Fire Exit Stair Enclosures - Refuge Space
clauses.note: Wheelchair refuge space inside exit stair landing must have minimum clear width of 750mm.

clauses.occupancy: Fire Exit Stair Enclosures - Refuge Space
clauses.note: Wheelchair refuge space inside exit stair landing must have minimum clear length of 1300mm.
Maximum allowable gradient for wheelchair accessible ramps is 1:12 (8.33% slope).
Minimum clear width between handrails on accessible ramps is 1200mm.
Clear door opening width for accessible routes and special needs facilities is minimum 900mm.
Accessible toilet must provide an unobstructed wheelchair turning circle of at least 1500mm diameter.
Main marina wharves and piers must provide at least 6.0m clear roadway for Civil Defence fire vehicles.
No point on a marina pier or boat mooring walkway shall be farther than 60m from a yard hydrant or standpipe.
Every drawing sheet submitted to Civil Defence must include a clear graphic scale bar (e.g. 1:100).
True North arrow must be indicated on all floor plans, site plans, and key plans.
All enclosed rooms must have clear text labels, floor areas in m2, and designated usage shown.
Title block must contain Project Name, Plot Number, Client, Consultant Stamp, Revision, and Date.
Where a floor plan is split across multiple sheets, a key plan showing the shaded zone is mandatory.
Standard Civil Defence color coding: Red = Fire Fighting, Yellow = Fuel/Gas, Green = Means of Egress.
